empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: There is nothing to show right now.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We could not load this. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact the programme team.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Check your internet connection and try again.

denied.title: You cannot open this
denied.description: Your role does not include this area. Go back to Home.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.invalid: The email, phone number or password is not right. Check and try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait one minute and try again.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is not working right now. Try again in a few minutes.
auth.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.
auth.expired: You were signed out after 30 minutes without activity. Sign in again.

wrongApp.title: Use the field app
wrongApp.description: Frontline staff work in the field app on their phone.

nothing.title: Nothing needs you right now
nothing.description: New work will show up here.

intro.STATE_ADMIN: Programme setup, oversight and audit across the state.
intro.DISTRICT_QM: Hospitals in your district: validations, escalations and progress.
intro.IPC_OFFICER: Your hospital: assessments, plans, validations and expert support.
intro.WARD_SUPERVISOR: Your wards: evidence to review and tasks to assign.
intro.EXTERNAL_AUDITOR: Read-only plans, evidence and history for your hospitals.

comingSoon.title: This area is not ready yet
comingSoon.description: It will be added soon. Use Home for your current work.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist. Go back to Home.

style.title: Design system
style.description: Tokens and components shared by the field app and the officer website.

colours.title: Colours
colours.note: Every text and background pair reaches a contrast of at least 4.5 : 1.
colours.caption: Semantic colour tokens

chips.title: Status, risk and legend chips
chips.note: Status is never shown by colour alone: each chip has a text label and an icon.

forms.title: Form fields
forms.noteHint: Up to 500 characters. Do not write patient details.

dialog.title: Confirm with a reason
dialog.note: Irreversible actions (return, validate, close, escalate) ask for confirmation and a reason.

boundary.title: Screen states
boundary.note: Every screen shows loading, empty, error, offline and no-permission states with a next step.
boundary.content: The screen content appears here when it is ready.

demo.returnDescription: The task goes back to its owner with your reason.

history.title: History
history.intro: Every recorded change to this {{type}}, oldest first.

empty.title: No changes recorded yet
empty.description: Changes appear here as soon as someone acts on this item.

admin.intro: Set up the programme: imports, people and scopes, cycles, rules and the demo clock.

confirm.noteHint: This note is kept in the audit history. Do not write patient details.

errors.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: This could not be saved. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact the programme team.
errors.CHECKLIST_PUBLISHED: This checklist version is published and cannot be changed. Create a new draft instead.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this since you opened it. Reload the page and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are missing or not valid. Check the fields below.
errors.ELEVATE_UNAVAILABLE: ELEVATE is not available right now. Nothing was changed; try again in a few minutes.
errors.DEMO_MODE_DISABLED: The demo clock is switched off in this environment.

imports.title: Import facilities and staff
imports.help: Upload a CSV file (up to 5 MB). Facility files create hospitals and wards; staff files create users, set their scope and deactivate people marked as left.
imports.fileRequired: Choose a CSV file to upload.
imports.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
imports.rowErrors: Rows that could not be imported

scopes.title: Users and scopes
scopes.emptyHelp: Import a staff file or add an assignment below.
scopes.userHint: ELEVATE user id (from the staff import).
scopes.endBody: {{user}} will lose access as {{role}} now. This is kept in the history.

cycles.title: Assessment cycles
cycles.solutionNote: Each cycle gets its own ELEVATE plan solution and checklist copy, so every ward can have one plan per cycle.

risk.title: Risk defaults
risk.help: These apply to findings from the next assessment. Tasks already created keep their rules.

rules.title: Escalation rules
rules.codeHint: R followed by a number, for example R4.
rules.levelAbove: The level above the person who decided

checklists.title: Checklists
checklists.intro: Published versions never change. A new version replaces the old one after a 7-day grace period; old assessments keep their questions.
checklists.emptyHelp: Ask the programme team to run the setup.
checklists.publishBody: After publishing, this version cannot be changed. {{previous}} stays usable for 7 days, then retires; its assessments keep their questions.
checklists.readOnly: This version is published and read-only.
checklists.question: Question

demoClock.title: Demo clock
demoClock.banner: Demo time: {{when}}. This is not real time.
demoClock.isShifted: Programme time is shifted for the demo.
demoClock.disabled: The demo clock can only be used in demo mode.
demoClock.elevateNote: Only programme dates move (due dates, escalations, offline limits, cycles). ELEVATE dates do not change.

plans.intro: Draft plans made from completed assessments, and the active plans of your hospital.
plans.draftIntro: Check the tasks, choose owners, set goals and milestones, then approve.
plans.readOnly: Only the IPC officer can change and approve this draft.

noActions.title: No actions needed
noActions.description: No draft plan is waiting. Assessments with no failed questions need no plan; new drafts appear here within a minute.

active.title: Active plans
active.emptyDescription: Approved plans of your hospital appear here.

editor.include: Include this task in the plan
editor.ownerNeeded: Choose who will do this task.
editor.saveFirst: Save your changes before you approve.
editor.ownersFirst: Every included task needs an owner before you approve.

approve.title: Approve this plan?
approve.description: {{count}} task(s) will be assigned to their owners and the ward plan is created in ELEVATE.
approve.done: Plan approved. Owners can now see their tasks.

carried.title: Carried over from the previous plan
carried.description: These tasks are still open from the last cycle. They stay linked to their first plan and are tracked here too.

findings.title: Findings from later assessments
findings.description: A later assessment in this cycle failed these questions. Add a task by changing the plan.

revise.title: Change the plan
revise.description: Your change is recorded as revision {{n}} with your reason.
revise.kind: What do you want to do?
revise.reasonHint: Up to 500 characters. Do not write patient details.
revise.done: Plan changed. The new revision is in the plan history.

errors.conflict: Someone changed this plan since you opened it. Reload the plan and make your change again.
errors.elevate: ELEVATE is not available, so the plan was not changed. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.validation: Some details are missing or not valid. Check the plan and try again.
errors.transition: This plan can no longer be changed this way. Reload the plan.
errors.denied: This plan is outside your area.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
errors.generic: The plan could not be saved. Try again.
